column1: # Same offset => same ISO and same epoch => the two rows serialise to the same bytes,
# which is the only thing do_archive's `grep -vxF` dedup can see. It exists to MEASURE
# a stated limit, not to assert a repair: two distinct events that serialise
# identically are indistinguishable to the archive.
# Reachable, not hypothetical: `release` archives at wave end, so
# leaves a second, genuinely new ACQUIRE that the next archive run drops as a
# duplicate of the first. All three commands inside one clock second is the only
# requirement, and a scripted wave does that.
